data.name: Isekai Mage Girl Gacha Pull Simulator: Elemental Card Collection
data.detailed_description:
What is "Isekai Gacha Simulator: Card Collection of Magical Battle Girls"?

"Isekai Gacha Simulator: Card Collection of Magical Battle Girls" is a gacha simulator built entirely around the thrill of the loop:

Earn → Pull → Get duplicates → Sell → Pull again.

No money? Go earn some.

Saved up? Hit the gacha.

Got a duplicate? Talk to the shopkeeper and sell it, then pull again.

——But a smart collector doesn't just sell.

In this game, all 50 cards have prices that fluctuate daily.

A card worth 700G yesterday could skyrocket to 2,758,800G today.

Check up to 30 days of price history on the chart screen, buy low, sell high——

Card collecting meets the thrill of trading.

You can buy cards too, not just sell.

Any card you've obtained before can be repurchased at 120% of its current selling price.

"Buy a crashing SSR cheap, then sell it when the price spikes"——

The profit becomes gacha funds, and the cycle never stops.

Manage your funds well and you'll unlock the 10-pull gacha, and eventually reach the "Ultimate Gacha" where SSR rates keep climbing.

SSRs almost never drop, so when one finally hits... the dopamine rush is unreal.

Outside of earning and gacha, the game is in 3D.

Display your cards in showcases, chat with the shopkeeper——the more you collect, the more your collection comes to life.

The goal is simple.

Complete all 50 cards of magical battle girls and fill every showcase.

When your wallet runs dry... time to go earn some more.

[KEY FEATURES]

NEW!! Card Price Charts: All 50 cards have daily fluctuating prices. View 30-day price history on line graphs and spot crashes and surges

NEW!! Card Purchase System: Repurchase owned cards at 120% of selling price. Buy low, sell high — card trading is now part of the game

NEW!! Trading Strategy: It's not just gacha anymore. Read the market, profit from trades, and use the earnings to pull even more

Updated from previous version: Gacha skip added! BGM added! Even more gorgeous characters!

All-in on gacha thrills: Flashy animations make every big pull feel amazing

Rarity: N / R / SR / SSR (SSR is ultra-rare — that's what makes it special)

Two types of guaranteed animations: You'll know when something big is coming

Duplicates are assets: Sell individual cards to reinvest and pull more

3 mini-games to earn money: Dishwashing / Construction site / Card sorting

3D shop with display & conversation: Arrange cards in showcases and feel like a true collector

Completion is the goal: All 50 cards, no additional content planned (one-time purchase, fully complete)

[GAME PROGRESSION]

Collect enough cards to unlock the 10-pull gacha (10th card has boosted SSR rate)

Collect more to unlock the Ultimate Gacha (SSR rate increases with each 10-pull)

Example: 5th 10-pull = 40% SSR / 7th = 50% / 10th = 90%

SSRs rotate daily: Available SSRs change each day, updating in sets of 5

Want a different SSR? Use the "advance day" button to re-target

Card prices change with each day too: Every time you advance a day, all card prices fluctuate. Master the timing of buying and selling!

[NOTICE]

This game uses in-game currency only. There are no real-money purchases or microtransactions.

All card trading and price fluctuations use in-game currency. No real money is involved whatsoever.

No romantic or sexual content.

All characters are fictional.

All characters are 18 years of age or older.

Streaming & Content Creation Policy

You are free to record, stream, and create content of this game. No prior notice or follow-up report is required.

Monetization (ads, donations, memberships, etc.) is permitted.

*In-game BGM uses royalty-free music.

*Please follow each platform's and rights holder's rules regarding third-party materials.

data.short_description: Earn, pull, trade, repeat — card prices change every day. Buy the crash, sell the surge. Card collection meets market trading. Gacha + chart-driven buy/sell in a new kind of simulator. The powered-up sequel to "Heroine Academy Gacha Simulator," which sold 1,000 copies in just 2 days!
